patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed-side execution reaches the same `psf_binheader_readf -> caf_read_header -> psf_log_printf` path on the original PoC, but the required 8-byte initialized prefix is restored at every selected event (`sixteen_bytes`, `chunk_size`, and `D` each measure 8 initialized bytes instead of 0), so the run stays clean while still genuinely exercising the protected desc-chunk logging path.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project statement on the vulnerable path that consumes the attacker-controlled desc-chunk header. This call asks libsndfile to parse a 4-byte marker, an 8-byte `chunk_size`, and 8 raw sample-rate bytes from the remaining file contents.

The `'8'` conversion uses `sixteen_bytes` as though `header_read()` had fully initialized it. Even after the short-read path returns without copying any bytes, this code decodes `sixteen_bytes` into `countdata` and stores the indeterminate result into the caller's `chunk_size`.
MemorySanitizer crash site. `%D` formatting has already loaded the caller's `chunk_size` vararg into local `D`, and this branch is the first executed use of that uninitialized value.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `chunk_size_decode.stored_chunk_size_bits == caf_desc_log.chunk_size_bits == 1208607915904008192`.
The vulnerable assertion trace records `caf_desc_log.chunk_size_bits == log_printf_D.d_bits == 1208607915904008192`.
